x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
cur_dif = float('inf')
ans_b, ans_a = 0, 0

def update(b, a):
    global cur_dif, ans_b, ans_a
    dif = abs((a / b) - (x / y))
    if dif + 1e-15 < cur_dif:
        cur_dif = dif
        ans_b = b
        ans_a = a

for b in range(1, n + 1):
    a1 = (x * b) // y
    a2 = a1 + 1
    update(b, a1)
    update(b, a2)

print(f"{ans_a}/{ans_b}")
